title: 1.5.0 release umbrella - the H3 cut on the 1.4.x line, a deviation from the 2.0 roadmap

summary: Phase 2 done and pushed as 2603f668 on branch 1.4.2: MPI-598 (Klein 9B - new model, klein_9b_t2i.json, 9 display webps, the seven-slot style rack), MPI-615 (SDXL/Illustrious/Pony/Krea 2 inpaint on the LanPaint path + krea2Turbo on the op), MPI-609 (style LoRAs named for their labels), MPI-575 (non-Flow half only) and MPI-605 (both LTX runtimes take ModelAttentionBackend - the plan's claim that the node was already on the branch was wrong, only the H3 pair had it). LanPaint added to node_lock, 16 packs; no Flow pack or audio dep crossed. Two commits rode along deliberately: MPI-619 (Klein 4B/9B carry their size in the name - without it 9B debuts under a shared name and the L/B letter, which is how a 9B style LoRA got picked for a 4B run) and c4208de8 (the pod-lock gate stops demanding a rebuild for installRequirements:false nodes - without it the Phase 3 smoke refuses over LanPaint). MPI-575's node_lock hunk was rejected by the 3-way and should have been: it moved MpiNodes BACKWARDS to 5e07043; the pin holds at 287edb83. 659/659 tests, 259/259 dep URLs, eslint clean, smoke --self-check OK.

Gate 1 done, f9566b6f. The drafted notes claimed the H3 encoder comes from our servers rather than HuggingFace and the handoff said to KEEP that half as still-true; it was FALSE on this branch - MPI-653 moved the encoder to R2 on master only, and Phase 1 restored the ethanfel HF url with no mirror, byte-identical to v1.4.4. Ported 9d724386 dep half (R2 primary, HF fallback, 0.66 MB/s -> 35.7-37.4 MB/s on 24.55GB) so the sentence describes what ships; release:deps 260/260. Notes also drop the 10 GB less claim (NVFP4 saving, moot), move 62 to 64, and add Klein 9B, inpaint on SDXL/Illustrious/Pony/Krea 2, the quality-tier RENAME as an Important change (a saved project reopens at a different canvas), faster long LTX clips, uninstall, video posters, the LTX preview flash and the remote-download trio - each Gate 0-checked against v1.4.4. Still agent draft, not approved copy.

Handoff 12135258. Phase 2 (2603f668), gate 1 notes (f9566b6f), DEV Pod pin fix (24d4905f) and twelve swept master fixes (f8a3096e) are pushed on 1.4.2; 666/666 tests, 260/260 dep URLs. RELEASE BLOCKER found live on Fabio 5090 run: the STABLE Pod image is v0.21.0 = ComfyUI 0.31.0 while this cut needs 0.34.0 core nodes - ModelAttentionBackend rejected on the Pod. 24d4905f fixed only the DEV pins; a stable rebuild at 0.34.0 (both legs) is the next action and must precede the smoke. Smoke is TWO runs - the matrix dedupes Klein 9B behind the cheaper 4B. MPI-556 owed (its test cannot resolve /js/utils/icons.js here). RAM floor needs deciding: 64 found no 5090 at all.
